parameters.query:
SELECT p.id, p.content, p.status, p.error_message, p.published_at,
       p.twitter_post_id, p.likes, p.retweets, p.replies,
       d.variant_label,
       n.title AS news_title, n.link AS news_link, n.source_name
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN drafts d ON p.draft_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN news_pool n ON d.news_id = n.id
WHERE p.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
  AND ({{ $json.hours }} = 0 OR p.published_at > now() - make_interval(hours => {{ $json.hours }}))
ORDER BY p.published_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;
